definitions.explanation: The act of descending or falling from a higher position. Used for physical descent such as parachuting, as well as drops in temperature, blood pressure, or other measurable quantities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{降下|こうか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
パラシュート⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{降下|こうか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。

⟦{血圧|けつあつ}→血圧：00218_ketsuatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急激|きゅうげき}→急激：02633_kyuugeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{降下|こうか}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運|はこ}ばれた→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: Because blood pressure dropped sharply, the patient was immediately taken to the hospital.

notes:
Composed of {降|こう} (descend) and {下|か} (down). Describes a downward movement or decrease, used in both physical and measurable contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{降下|こうか}: temperature drop
- ⟦{血圧|けつあつ}→血圧：00218_ketsuatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{降下|こうか}: blood pressure drop
- {降下|こうか}⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧: descent training (parachute)
- ⟦{急降下|きゅうこうか}→急降下：25672_kyuukouka⟧: nosedive, steep descent
- {落下傘|らっかさん}{降下|こうか}: parachute descent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧: decline, deterioration — used for quality, ability, or levels declining over time
- {降下|こうか}: descent, drop — emphasizes physical downward movement or sudden decrease
- ⟦{下降|かこう}→下降：00153_kakou⟧: descent, going down — more neutral term for downward movement
- ⟦{落下|らっか}→落下：14051_rakka⟧: falling — an object dropping due to gravity

REGISTER:
Formal and technical. Common in news reports, medical contexts, and military terminology. In everyday speech, ⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧ is more natural for describing drops in temperature or pressure.
